create_random_sampler: create a RandomSampler instance with num samples, pos_fraction, and add_gt_as_proposals settings
random_choice_select: randomly select num elements from a Tensor, ndarray, or list gallery pool
sample_positive_indices: sample positive bounding box indices from an AssignResult using random selection
sample_negative_indices: sample negative bounding box indices from an AssignResult using random selection
register_random_sampler: register the RandomSampler class in the TASK_UTILS registry for mmdet task modules
